segments.title: No reply? Send this
segments.say: Got no reply? This prompt writes a follow-up people actually answer.

segments.title: Paste your first email
segments.say: Paste the email you sent, and how long ago you sent it.
Write a three line follow-up. One clear question. No guilt trip.
segments.text: Write a 3-line follow-up. One clear question. No guilt-trip.

segments.title: Short beats pushy
segments.say: Short and specific is easier to answer than pushy.
segments.text: Hi Sam, quick nudge on my note from last week. Could you confirm by Friday? Thanks!

segments.title: Easy to answer
segments.say: One question, a clear deadline, an easy yes or no.
Save this for your next unanswered email, and follow for one prompt a day.
